other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered construction worker under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board or a dependent child of such a worker.
Must have at least one year of board membership before the marriage.
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The family can avail the assistance only twice.
The son or daughter must be of legal age for marriage.
Application for the benefit should be submitted within 6 months of the marriage.
Registration renewal required every 3 years with a 1‑year grace period.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹60,000 for the worker's own marriage or for two dependent children's marriages.
